description: An interactive field guide to the two Moon rockets: why reaching the Moon takes about 12 km/s and why that forces staging, the Saturn V's real Apollo 11 stage masses run through the rocket equation, the Soviet N1's 30 first-stage engines and its engine-control system, and the four N1 launches that failed between 1969 and 1972.
og: Apollo 11's real stage masses through the rocket equation, and what happens when an N1 loses engines — the two Moon rockets, interactive and sourced.
brand: THRUST — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
